name: tena-search
description: >A hospital service directory for Ethiopia that helps you find nearby healthcare facilities with the service you need, right now! > **Status:** 🚧 In development. Core search and dashboards are being built. ## Why   When someone needs urgent care, calling around or driving to a facility that   turns out to lack the right service wastes critical time. Patients have no   reliable way to see what a hospital offers at that moment.
